SQL Injection.strategy: Look for f-strings or string concatenation in database queries. Check cursor.execute() calls for direct variable interpolation instead of parameterized queries.

Command Injection.strategy: Search for os.system(), subprocess.run() with shell=True, or eval() calls that include user input without sanitization.

Cross-Site Scripting (XSS).strategy: Look for '| safe' filter in Jinja templates or direct HTML string formatting with user input. Check render_template_string() calls.
